definitions.gloss: to photograph; to take a picture
definitions.explanation: To capture a still image using a camera or smartphone.

definitions.gloss: to film; to shoot (video or movie)
definitions.explanation: To record moving images for a film, video, TV program, or other media production.

notes:
Covers both still photography and video/film recording. More formal than ⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧, which is the everyday word for taking photos.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{撮影|さつえい}する: to take a photo
- ⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{撮影|さつえい}する: to shoot a video
- ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧: film shooting
- ⟦{撮影|さつえい}{禁止|きんし}→撮影禁止：26565_satsueikinshi⟧: photography/filming prohibited
- ⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧: filming location, set
- ⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧: filming/photography permit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧: to take (a photo) — everyday casual word
- ⟦{録画|ろくが}→録画：04441_rokuga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to record (video) — emphasizes the recording/saving aspect
- ⟦{収録|しゅうろく}→収録：08378_shuuroku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to record (a TV show) — typically in a studio setting
